title: Tailwind CSS v4
simpleMetaphor: Style UI directly in HTML using pre-built utility classes without separate stylesheet files.
technicalExplanation: Utility-first CSS framework with an updated Rust-powered Oxide engine in v4 for instant builds.

title: SASS/SCSS
simpleMetaphor: Traditional CSS with extra powers like variables, nesting, and reusable mixins.
technicalExplanation: CSS preprocessor extending standard syntax with SCSS features before compiling to standard CSS.

title: CSS Modules
simpleMetaphor: Scopes CSS class names automatically so styles in one component never break another.
technicalExplanation: CSS file compilation process that scopes class names and animation names locally by default.

title: Styled Components
simpleMetaphor: Write actual CSS directly inside your React JavaScript component files.
technicalExplanation: CSS-in-JS library using tagged template literals to style React components dynamically with props.

title: Shadcn UI
simpleMetaphor: Tailwind component code that you copy directly into your project for 100% style control.
technicalExplanation: Re-usable component library built on Radix Primitives and Tailwind CSS for accessible design.

title: Radix Primitives
simpleMetaphor: Unstyled, accessible building blocks (modals, dropdowns) that you can style however you want.
technicalExplanation: Unstyled, accessible UI component primitives for React focusing on WAI-ARIA compliance.

title: DaisyUI
simpleMetaphor: Adds component class names (btn, card) on top of Tailwind CSS to write cleaner HTML.
technicalExplanation: Tailwind CSS plugin providing semantic component classes without inline utility clutter.

title: Storybook
simpleMetaphor: An isolated workshop to build and test UI components in isolation before adding them to your main app.
technicalExplanation: Development environment for UI components enabling isolated rendering, documentation, and testing.
